- File: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py (lines 523-526 in current last_run_diff / _build_scope after last autofix)
  Problem: The whitespace-strip guard for `scope_level_override` was added, but invalid non-empty scope values can still abort the memory-maintenance path with MemoryValidationError.
  Why it fails at runtime: memory_retrieve / memory_record_candidate with malformed `--scope-level` from a future caller (or shell expansion bug) aborts the memory-maintenance extraction step (even though it is supposed to be fail-open).
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml (lines ~58-360 in PR diff)
  Problem: The extraction step only considers records under `task_summaries`, so promoted `repo_learnings` records are never self-fed into later runs.
  Why it fails at runtime: On subsequent monthly runs the learnings pipeline starves itself (no new items promoted after the first batch), silently growing the ai-memory branch with duplicates while the compaction step continues.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  SEVERITY: MAJOR

  Issue: MemoryValidationError on invalid scope_level is correct but aborts the entire memory_retrieve call; extraction step in memory_maintenance.yml is marked continue-on-error but the retrieval failure still emits a traceback before the shell guard.
  Suggested minimal fix: wrap the normalized check in a try/except MemoryValidationError that falls back to "global" and logs a notice (mirrors the rest of the fail-open path).
